## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.


```{r DataUrbantransitVorbereiten}
# Datensatz einlesten
urban <- read_dta("Data/UrbanTransitReports.dta")

# Spaltennamen übersetzen
urban_en <- urban %>%
  rename(
    year_rel = year,
    city_id = id,
    gdp = GDP
  ) %>%
  rename(
    city = `城市`,
    year = `年份`,
    pop_10k = `年末总人口万`,
    city_district_pop_10k = `市辖区年末总人口万`,
    n_bus = `年末实有公共汽电车营运车辆数辆`,
    bus_mileage_10k_km = `公共汽电车运营里程万公里`,
    bus_ridership_10k = `公共汽电车客运量万人次`,
    n_taxi = `出租汽车车辆数运营车数合计辆`,
    taxi_mileage_10k_km = `出租汽车运营里程万公里`,
    taxi_trips_10k = `出租汽车载客车次总数万车次`,
    taxi_ridership_10k = `出租汽车客运量万人次`,
    n_subway_vehicle = `轨道交通运营车数辆`,
    n_subway_lines = `轨道交通运营线路条数合计条`,
    subway_length_total_km = `轨道交通运营线路总长度公里`,
    subway_length_km = `轨道交通运营线路长度公里`,
    subway_mileage_10k_train_km = `轨道交通运营里程万列公里`,
    subway_ridership_10k = `轨道交通客运量万人次`,
    road_surface_10k_sqm = `年末实有城市道路面积万平方米`,
    road_surface_per_capita_sqm = `人均城市道路面积平方米`,
    n_civilian_cars_10k = `民用汽车拥有量万辆`,
    n_private_cars_10k = `私人汽车拥有量万辆`,
    district_gdp_per_capita_yuan = `人均地区生产总值元`,
    urban_disposable_income_per_capita_yuan = `城镇居民人均可支配收入元`,
    urban_consumption_expenditure_per_capita_yuan = `城镇居民人均生活消费性支出元`,
    subway_open_year = `地铁开通年份`,
    has_subway = `是否开通地铁`,
    city_gdp_per_capita_yuan = `城市人均GDP`
  )
# Alle Städtenamen für Übersetzung raussuchen
unique(urban_en$city)

# Neue Spalte mit übersetzten Städtenamen und Reihenfolge für Übersichtlichkeit anpassen
urban_en <- urban_en %>%
  mutate(
    city_en = recode(
      city,
      "上海" = "Shanghai",
      "北京" = "Beijing",
      "南京" = "Nanjing",
      "南宁" = "Nanning",
      "南昌" = "Nanchang",
      "厦门" = "Xiamen",
      "合肥" = "Hefei",
      "哈尔滨" = "Harbin",
      "大连" = "Dalian",
      "天津" = "Tianjin",
      "广州" = "Guangzhou",
      "成都" = "Chengdu",
      "昆明" = "Kunming",
      "杭州" = "Hangzhou",
      "武汉" = "Wuhan",
      "沈阳" = "Shenyang",
      "深圳" = "Shenzhen",
      "石家庄" = "Shijiazhuang",
      "福州" = "Fuzhou",
      "西安" = "Xi'an",
      "贵阳" = "Guiyang",
      "郑州" = "Zhengzhou",
      "重庆" = "Chongqing",
      "长春" = "Changchun",
      "长沙" = "Changsha"
    )
  ) %>%
  relocate(city_en, .after = city)

urban_en <- urban_en %>%
  relocate(city_id, .before = city)

```

```{r DataSubwayLines}
# Datensatz laden
lines <- read_dta("Data/SubwayLines.dta")

# Wie im Original Hong Kong entfernen
lines_nohk <- lines %>%
  filter(city != "Hong Kong")

lines_nohk %>%
  count(city, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r Fig1Vorbereiten}
# Datensatz urban_en für Fig 1, zuerst irrelevante Spalten entfernen

urban_fig1 <- urban_en %>%
  select(city, city_en, year, subway_length_total_km, subway_ridership_10k)


#  Aggregieren auf Jahresebene, Pendant zu diesem Stata Befehl: collapse (sum) subway_length subway_ridership, by(year)

annual_temp <- urban_fig1 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    subway_length = sum(subway_length_total_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    subway_ridership = sum(subway_ridership_10k, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Im Vorbild ist die Ridership in Millionen angegeben, deswegen müssen die Werte umgerechnet werden

annual_temp <- annual_temp %>%
  mutate(
    subway_ridership = subway_ridership / 100
  )


# Jahr 2009 entfernen, da es keine Ridership enthält, Datenfehler?

annual_temp <- annual_temp %>%
  filter(year != 2009)




# der Rest der Daten kommt aus SubwayLines.dta, hier lines_nohk
# Wir beginnen damit, für jedes Eröffnungsjahr die neu hinzugekommene Streckenlänge aufzusummieren

lines_year <- lines_nohk %>%
  group_by(openyear) %>%
  summarise(
    lengthkm = sum(lengthkm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(openyear)

# Daraus bilden wir die laufende kumulative Summe, sprich die tatsächliche Länge für jedes Jahr
lines_year <- lines_year %>%
  mutate(
    subway_length2 = cumsum(lengthkm)
  )


# für merge openyear in year umbenennen

lines_year <- lines_year %>%
  rename(year = openyear) %>%
  select(year, subway_length2)


```

```{r merge fig1}
# Die beiden vorbereiteten Datensätze werden zusammengefügt, full join, damit keine Daten verloren gehen

fig1_df <- full_join(lines_year, annual_temp, by = "year") %>%
  arrange(year)


# NA Werte statt 0 wie im Stata Code

fig1_df <- fig1_df %>%
  mutate(
    subway_ridership = na_if(subway_ridership, 0),
    subway_length = na_if(subway_length, 0)
  )


# Labels von Vorbild Grafik übernehmen

fig1_df <- fig1_df %>%
  mutate(
    NCities = case_when(
      year == 2000 ~ "4 cities",
      year == 2017 ~ "30 cities",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# wie in originaler Grafik Begrenzung auf Jahre ab 2000
plot_df <- fig1_df %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2017)

```

```{r plotfig1}
# ggplot benötigt einen skalierungsfaktor für die rechte achse
scale_factor <- 3.2


# Plot erstellen

p_fig1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_line(
    # Graph Ridership
    data = plot_df %>% filter(year >= 2002, !is.na(subway_ridership)),
    aes(y = subway_ridership, color = "ridership"),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    # Graph Length
    data = plot_df %>% filter(year >= 2002, !is.na(subway_length2)),
    aes(y = subway_length2 * scale_factor, color = "length"),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    linetype = "31"
  ) +
  # Achsen und Skalen konfigurieren und Skalenstriche hinzufügen
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020),
    limits = c(2000, 2020)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "total ridership (million)",
    breaks = c(0, 5000, 10000, 15000),
    limits = c(0, 16000),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / scale_factor,
      name = "total length (km)",
      breaks = c(0, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000)
    )
  ) +
  # Farben mit Hexpicker aus Original übernommen
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("ridership" = "#6d8d84", "length" = "#90343a"),
    breaks = c("ridership", "length")
  ) +
  # X-Achse beschriftung
  labs(
    x = "year",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  # Labels aus Original für Anzahl der Städte 2002 und 2017
  geom_text(
    data = tibble(
      x = c(2000.2, 2017.5),
      y = c(236 * scale_factor + 100, 4476 * scale_factor + 100),
      label = c("4 cities", "30 cities")
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 2.8,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = c(-0.1, -0.15)
  ) +
  # Legende hinzugefügt
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        linewidth = c(1.3, 1.3),
        linetype = c("solid", "dashed")
      )
    )
  ) +
  # Theme mit Farben, Positionen und vertikalen Skalenbeschriftungen
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(2.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.margin = margin(6, 10, 6, 10),
  
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.right = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.x.top = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
  
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      margin = margin(l = 12)
    ),
    # Aspect Ratio vom Original übernommen
    aspect.ratio = 0.674
  )

p_fig1

# Grafik als png speichern
ggsave(
  filename = "FertigeGrafiken/Fig1_R.png",
  plot = p_fig1
)


```
